messages:
Eli: FYI escalated from customer AcmeCorp — tenant-view latency percentiles (p95/p99) disappeared from the dashboard after the canary deploy. They only see p50 and avg. Screenshot: https://acme.mock/s/shot.png
Owen: ack, which dashboard exactly? tenant view or org/global? timeframe?
Eli: tenant view for tenant=acme-prod. Customer says last good around 2024-12-08T03:12Z, canary window 02:45-03:00Z. Repro steps I used: 1) open /dash/latency/tenants 2) set tenant=acme-prod 3) set metric=latency + percentiles overlay -> only see 0.5 quantile
Aisha: sounds like a telemetry transform may have normalized labels. Can you dump series for that tenant?
ObservabilityBot: query job started id=qb-9982 (querying series api for tenant=acme-prod)
Owen: run `curl -s "${OBS_API}/series?tenant=acme-prod&metric=latency&from=1700000000&to=1700003600" | jq '.series[].labels'` -> output shows some series with `quantile` and some without
Eli: snippet: ```[{"labels": {"metric": "latency","tenant":"acme-prod","quantile":"0.5"}}, {"labels": {"metric":"latency","tenant":"acme-prod"}}]``` second object missing quantile label for tail series
Aisha: that explains it — dashboard panel queries for `quantile=0.95|0.99` so if those labels were dropped the panel finds nothing. Which transform added this?
Owen: tracked a recent infra PR: infra/telemetry#884 introduced `stats-shaper` in the canary that collapses derived series and when `aggregate=true` it strips non-essential labels, looks like `quantile` got dropped for derived percentile series. Canary rolled to 3 nodes during window
Eli: customer is upset, asking for ETA. Any quick mitigation that doesn't require them changing dashboards?
Aisha: Short-term we can flip a feature flag to preserve percentiles: `telemetry.patch.keep_quantiles=true` for the canary ring, or revert the stats-shaper config. Long-term we need a code fix to preserve `quantile` on percentile derivation and add an integ test.
Owen: I'm going to flip the FF for canary ring. Command: `kubectl -n telemetry set env ds/telemetry-collector TELEMETRY_KEEP_QUANTILES=true --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -`
DeployBot: rollout started telemetry-collector canary -> 3/3 updated
Owen: patch applied, waiting for metrics to repopulate (give it ~10m)
Eli: I told the customer we're rolling a config change and will follow up in 15m :thumbsup:
ObservabilityBot: new series detected for tenant=acme-prod including quantile=0.95 at 2145679305
Aisha: verified on our side — p95/p99 are back in tenant view. Root cause: stats-shaper dropped `quantile` when merging derived series under aggregate=true. I'll open a hotfix PR to preserve `quantile` and add a test; target hotfix branch.
Eli: thanks everyone — marking this escalated/high priority in the ticket and will confirm with customer before closing
Owen: noted, tagging eng oncall @Aisha
